description:
Update a campaign's configuration. Workflow config changes are merged with existing settings.

Use this to change the search query, max results, or toggle workflow steps (site scraping, email verification) on an active campaign.

social_media_enrichment.description: Social Media Enrichment fallback (recover social-media contact info for businesses with no verified email). Only effective for clients whose plan includes it. Default ON (opt-out).

enabled.description: Enable/disable Social Media Enrichment for this campaign.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: update_campaign
